record_scope_reconstruction: The Israeli-controlled cargo ban affected Kerem Shalom, Erez and Erez West/Zikim, the three aid entry points identified in contemporaneous OCHA logistics reporting. Rafah is not substituted.

source_checks.finding: OCHA lists pre-suspension convoys to Erez West, Erez and Kerem Shalom and states cargo could not be collected at any crossing after March2; names Zikim and Erez separately.
OCHA distinguishes permission on May18, incoming supplies through Kerem Shalom, and subsequent May21 collection/distribution.
